data.title: 祀 · 书桌前蘸墨为你画小葱
data.action: 手握毛笔展示案头宣纸画作
data.lighting: 明亮温暖的室内漫射光
data.description: 基地书房的午后，祀手执饱蘸浓墨的毛笔，在宣纸上灵巧地勾勒出一根圆滚滚的可爱小葱，抬起头狡黠地偏着脑袋望向你，龙尾在身后轻轻晃动——「他们总说我的发型像小葱……喏，画下来送给你，可不准笑我。」
data.promptProse: Holding a traditional calligraphy brush above a desk covered in ink-wash sketches, Si tilts her head with a teasing grin, displaying a playful ink doodle on the paper.
data.animaCaption: She holds the calligraphy brush poised above the paper and smiles playfully toward the viewer.
